nodes.label: Merge repeat submissions (30 min)
nodes.rationale: Same phone across sources becomes one lead and one call.

nodes.label: Outbound webhook events
nodes.rationale: CRM sync goes through the outbound webhook (Zapier/Make) for now.

nodes.label: Calling hours (8am-9pm)
nodes.rationale: Keeps calls inside TCPA quiet hours; leads outside the window are called when it opens and told so by text.

nodes.label: TCPA prior express consent
nodes.rationale: The FCC treats AI-generated voices as artificial voice under the TCPA, so prior express consent is required.

nodes.label: Durable SQLite job queue
nodes.rationale: Calls, re-dials, callbacks, texts and webhooks survive restarts.

nodes.label: Single-instance deployment limit
nodes.rationale: Live calls are held in memory and the database is SQLite; scaling out would need Postgres plus sticky WebSocket routing.

nodes.label: Google Calendar booking
nodes.rationale: Without a calendar the AI still offers times within booking hours and texts the team to confirm.

nodes.label: Estimate booking fallback
nodes.rationale: If nobody accepts the transfer or it is after hours, the AI reconnects with full context and books the estimate.

nodes.label: Claude phone model (ANTHROPIC_MODEL)
nodes.rationale: Runs at low effort for snappy phone replies; can switch to a smaller model or raise effort.

nodes.label: AI appointment assistant
nodes.rationale: Its first line is a fixed template so the lead hears it the instant they say hello.

nodes.label: Warm transfer (owner then manager, press 1)
nodes.rationale: Team member hears a short whisper summary and presses 1 to accept; otherwise the next person is tried.

nodes.label: Flow tests (scripted model + fake carrier)
nodes.rationale: Drive the real HTTP routes and WebSocket the way Twilio does; check Claude history stays append-only across transfer.

nodes.label: Speed to Lead system
nodes.rationale: Call a homeowner within seconds of a form submit, qualify them with AI, then transfer live or book an estimate.
